domainSeparationConfirm.title: Save dual-domain settings?
domainSeparationConfirm.description:
After saving, only the site URL can serve the admin UI and API, and only the image URL can serve public image links. Access via IP, an unlisted Host, or a reverse proxy that does not forward Host correctly may lock you out of the admin UI.

If locked out, run docker exec pichost clear-domains (local dev: npm run clear-domains), or disable domain separation in Settings when you can access it again.

Save anyway?
